insight.title: Why Copying Winners Makes You Lose
insight.subtitle: How following industry leaders causes you to inherit their mistakes

sections.text: We watch a market leader and assume their newest move is genius. We rush to mirror it. Usually, they are just experimenting, and now you are both lost on the same map.

This is "Strategic Mimicry." We incorrectly believe that because a company is bigger, they are more certain. But size often masks confusion. Copying them doesn't lower your risk; it just removes your edge.
Real strategy is found in the gaps others leave behind. If your roadmap is a mirror of someone else’s, you aren’t building a business—you are simply building a shadow of one.
Try this today: When you think about a competitor today, ask if you actually want their specific problems.
You cannot win the race if you are only following someone else's footprints.

news.title: The U.S. economy almost stalled, but inflation still stayed too hot for an easy Fed rescue
news.description: U.S. growth slowed sharply while inflation stayed elevated, limiting Fed flexibility and keeping markets focused on policy risk and the next macro trigger.

news.title: Stocks Rebound on Hopes Ceasefire Deal Will Hold: Markets Wrap
news.description: (Bloomberg) -- Wall Street traders paced a rebound in stocks as an oil rally waned after Israel agreed to direct talks with Lebanon, bolstering expectations that a US ceasefire deal will hold.

news.title: Inflation Surge Sparks Rift in Mexico's Central Bank Over Interest Rates
news.description: A division within Mexico's central bank has intensified following a sharp rise in inflation, as revealed by new data reaching a year-and-a-half high in March. The bank's March 26 meeting minutes expose a split over the decision to cut interest rates amid rising inflation and geopolitical uncertainties.

news.title: Iran conflict: Pharma supply chains may take months to recover
news.description: The recent ceasefire in the Iran conflict is a much-needed breath of fresh air for India's pharmaceutical sector, potentially rejuvenating exports. Nevertheless, industry specialists warn that it may take considerable time for supply chains to fully recover. Although raw material costs are projected to decrease slowly, West Asia remains a crucial market for Indian generics.

news.title: USPS to Suspend Payments to Employee Pension Plan to Free up Cash
news.description: The US Postal Service said Thursday it would temporarily suspend payments to an employee pension plan to free up cash amid a financial crisis.

news.title: Lawmakers demand investigations into well-timed bets on Polymarket tied to the Iran war
news.description: Calls are increasing inside Congress for investigations into the prediction market platform Polymarket.
